concepts.concept_name_english: Difference Function Minimum & Common Tangent Theorem
concepts.academic_definition: If f(x) >= g(x) for all x and f(x_0)=g(x_0), then x_0 is a local minimum of h(x)=f(x)-g(x), implying h'(x_0)=0 and f'(x_0)=g'(x_0).
|f(x)-k| is differentiable across real numbers if and only if at every root x_0 where f(x_0)=k, f'(x_0)=0.
For any cubic polynomial, the distance from local extremum tangent point x_1 to the local extremum x_ext and intersection point x_2 satisfies |x_ext - x_1| : |x_2 - x_ext| = 2 : 1.
